girdi.command: ls -R core test 2>/dev/null | head -60 && echo "--- AGENTS ---" && cat AGENTS.md
girdi.description: List core/test tree and read AGENTS.md

girdi.command: cd core/hooks && grep -n "^function short\|^function lastText\|^function job\|^const LEDGER\|^function audit\|^function turn\|^function handle\|^function file\|^function sum\|^function items\|^function transcript\|^function entries\|^function prompt" defter.js count.js kitap.js mod.js && echo "=== short ===" && sed -n "/^function short/,/^}/p" defter.js && echo "=== count file/sum/handle ===" && sed -n "/^function file/,/^}/p;/^function sum/,/^}/p" count.js && echo "=== audit ===" && sed -n "/^function audit/,/^}/p" kitap.js
cd core/hooks && sed -n '241,300p' count.js && echo "=== dur strings ===" && grep -n '"dur\.\|"banner\.\(lang\|evidence\|ui\|jobs\)' ../strings.json | head -30
cd core/hooks && grep -n "SHORT\s*=\|MAX_LINES\s*=\|^function off\|^function open\|^function lastText" -A6 defter.js | head -45 && echo "=== mod.items ===" && sed -n '209,225p' mod.js
girdi.description: Read defter.js gate internals and mod.items

girdi.command: cd core/hooks && echo '{"hook_event_name":"Stop","session_id":"deneme","cwd":"'"$PWD"'","last_assistant_message":"tamam"}' | node dur.js; echo "[cikis: $?]"
girdi.description: Run dur.js with a sample Stop payload
